newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices fall along with volume.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices fall along with volume.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange receded to 552 kg on Wednesday as gold prices fell, after surging to 1,160 kg on Tuesday, dealers said.
Prices sank to $351.50 an ounce from $356.60 on Tuesday, following world trends, and to 1,309,700 lira per gramme versus Tuesday's 1,334,100.
The Turkish currency closed at 115,800 lira to the dollar against Tuesday's 116,000.
Of the day's trade, 462 kg was conducted in the morning session and 73.7 percent of the total was traded in lira terms.
